name: 77044 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77044 (Houston) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77044 (Houston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77044 (Houston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
